info.title: CogniBoiler API Gateway
info.description: REST and WebSocket gateway of the CogniBoiler digital twin: sign-in and sessions, plant state, PLC commands, simulation control, alarms, history, audit and user administration. Errors are Problem Details (RFC 9457).

get.description: Liveness probe: the process runs and its event loop answers.
Readiness probe with the state of the database and every upstream service.

post.description:
Sign in with a username and password.

An unknown user, a wrong password and a blocked account get the same 401. After too
many failures for one account name or one client the answer is 429 with Retry-After,
again whether or not the account exists.

Exchange a refresh token for a new pair; the presented token becomes unusable.

Presenting an exchanged token again closes the whole session.

Close the session of the presented refresh token (body or cookie) or bearer token.

Always answers 200, so it reveals nothing about the token.

get.description: The signed-in user with their current role.

post.description:
Change the signed-in user's password.

Every session of the user is closed, including this one; the response carries a
fresh session. Wrong current passwords count toward the sign-in throttle.

get.description: Return the current boiler and turbine state from live gRPC.
The latest plant step: measurements, valves, emissions, health, faults.

post.description: Advance a paused simulation by whole steps.
Restart the plant from a scenario; the PLC follows the new run.
Inject a labelled fault; the physics engine validates target and severity.

get.description: Scenario loads and fault changes, newest first, with who made them.

post.description: Send a manual valve command to the PLC; the PLC switches to MANUAL.
Set the electrical load the PLC drives the unit to in AUTO.
Switch the PLC between AUTO and MANUAL, or trip the unit.
Update live PLC setpoints and return the acceptance status.

Reset the PLC emergency stop latch once its cause is gone; back to AUTO.

The reset is recorded under the authenticated user. An operator_id in the body no
longer overrides that; it is kept in the audit detail as a note.

get.description: Current PLC mode, targets, loops, alarm conditions and reset permission.

Telemetry over a bounded range at a resolution chosen from its length.

The range is split into standard windows (1 s … 1 day) so that it fits in `limit`
points; each point is the mean of its window.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Only alarms of this severity; all when omitted.

AlarmDetailResponse.title: AlarmDetailResponse
AlarmDetailResponse.description: An alarm with its transitions, oldest first.

alarm_id.title: Alarm Id
alarm_id.description: The alarm id as a string.

key.title: Key
key.description: Condition identity; one open alarm per key.

AlarmResponse.title: AlarmResponse
AlarmResponse.description:
An alarm with its lifecycle.

`alarm_id`, `occurred_at_ms`, `acknowledged` and `cleared` keep their earlier
meaning; `state` is the full lifecycle state.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Source service or the user who acknowledged.

AlarmTransitionResponse.title: AlarmTransitionResponse
AlarmTransitionResponse.description: One state change of an alarm.

AuditPageResponse.title: AuditPageResponse
AuditPageResponse.description: A page of audit entries, newest first.

role.title: Role
role.description: Role the user held when acting.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: How the action ended, e.g. accepted, refused: <reason>.

AuditResponse.title: AuditResponse
AuditResponse.description: Audit log entry returned by the API gateway.

BoilerStatusResponse.title: BoilerStatusResponse
BoilerStatusResponse.description:
Current boiler state as returned by GET /api/v1/status.
All values in SI units, matching BoilerStateMsg fields exactly
so the gateway can populate this schema directly from protobuf.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: True if the command was accepted.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Rejection reason. Empty string when accepted=True.

CommandAckResponse.title: CommandAckResponse
CommandAckResponse.description:
Response body for all command endpoints.
Mirrors CommandAck from the protobuf schema.
If accepted=False, reason explains why the command was rejected
(e.g. value out of safe range, safety interlock active).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: PLC operating mode to switch to.

ControlModeRequest.title: ControlModeRequest
ControlModeRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/commands/mode.
Requires minimum role: operator. "estop" is a manual trip; only a reset clears it.

target.title: Target
target.description: Valve (fuel, feedwater, steam, spray) or sensor id, if the kind needs one.

values.title: Values
values.description: Field/value map for the historical row.

HistoryPointResponse.title: HistoryPointResponse
HistoryPointResponse.description: One historical telemetry row returned from InfluxDB.

window_s.title: Window S
window_s.description: Each point is the mean over a window this long [s].

HistoryResponse.title: HistoryResponse
HistoryResponse.description: Historical telemetry over a bounded range at an automatic resolution.

samples.title: Samples
samples.description: Plant status samples in the range.

turbine_heat_rate_j_per_j.title: Turbine Heat Rate J Per J
turbine_heat_rate_j_per_j.description: Heat to the cycle per unit of electricity [J/J].

plant_heat_rate_j_per_j.title: Plant Heat Rate J Per J
plant_heat_rate_j_per_j.description: Fuel heat per unit of electricity [J/J].

LoadDemandRequest.title: LoadDemandRequest
LoadDemandRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/commands/load.
Requires minimum role: operator. The unit ramps to the new load at 30 MW/min.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description:
Request body for POST /auth/login.
Both fields are required. Passwords are never logged or stored
in plain text — only the Argon2id hash is persisted.

LogoutRequest.title: LogoutRequest
LogoutRequest.description:
Request body for POST /auth/logout; omit it to use the refresh cookie or the bearer
token. The whole session of the token is closed.

MessageResponse.title: MessageResponse
MessageResponse.description: Generic single-message response used across multiple endpoints.

active_setpoints.description: Working setpoints ramping toward the targets.

PLCStatusResponse.title: PLCStatusResponse
PLCStatusResponse.description: Mode, targets, working setpoints, loops and alarm conditions of the PLC.

turbine_heat_rate_j_per_j.title: Turbine Heat Rate J Per J

plant_heat_rate_j_per_j.title: Plant Heat Rate J Per J

PlantStateResponse.title: PlantStateResponse
PlantStateResponse.description: Everything the physics engine publishes about the plant at one step.

telemetry_age_s.title: Telemetry Age S
telemetry_age_s.description: Seconds since the gateway last received a plant state.

ProfileResponse.title: ProfileResponse
ProfileResponse.description: The signed-in user, as the gateway sees them now.

RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest
RefreshRequest.description: Request body for POST /auth/refresh; omit it to use the refresh cookie.

operator_id.title: Operator Id
operator_id.description: Operator identifier recorded in the reset audit trail.

pressure_pa.title: Pressure Pa
pressure_pa.description: Target drum pressure [Pa]. Safe range: 50–185 bar.

steam_temp_k.title: Steam Temp K
steam_temp_k.description: Target steam temperature [K]. Safe range: 400–848 K.

SetpointRequest.title: SetpointRequest
SetpointRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/commands/setpoint.
Requires minimum role: engineer.
All three setpoints must be provided together — the cascade PID
controller uses them as a consistent set.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Changes whenever a scenario is loaded.

SystemStatusResponse.title: SystemStatusResponse
SystemStatusResponse.description:
Full system state: boiler + turbine combined.
Returned by GET /api/v1/status.

expires_in.title: Expires In
expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

session_expires_at_ms.title: Session Expires At Ms
session_expires_at_ms.description: When the session ends and a new sign-in is needed [UTC ms].

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description:
Response body for POST /auth/login, POST /auth/refresh and POST /auth/password.
access_token  — short-lived (15 min), used in the Authorization header; keep it in
                memory.
refresh_token — valid until the session expires (7 days after sign-in), exchanged
                once at /auth/refresh. Browsers should rely on the httpOnly cookie
                set with the same value and never store this field.

TurbineStatusResponse.title: TurbineStatusResponse
TurbineStatusResponse.description:
Current turbine state as returned by GET /api/v1/status.
All values in SI units, matching TurbineStateMsg fields exactly.

role.title: Role
role.description: None if the account has no role.

open_sessions.title: Open Sessions
open_sessions.description: Sessions that can still be refreshed.

UserUpdateRequest.title: UserUpdateRequest
UserUpdateRequest.description: Change the role, block or unblock. Either change closes the user's sessions.

fuel_valve.title: Fuel Valve
fuel_valve.description: Fuel valve position [0.0 = closed, 1.0 = fully open].

spray_valve.title: Spray Valve
spray_valve.description: Attemperator spray valve position [0.0 – 1.0]; omitted keeps it.

ValveCommandRequest.title: ValveCommandRequest
ValveCommandRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/commands/valve.
Requires minimum role: operator.
All three valve positions must be provided together to avoid
partial state updates that could destabilise the control loop.
